scope: Seven commercial or legacy Android reader product families, using the official sources already reviewed. Free and paid editions are grouped with entitlement limitations. Features are publisher documentation, not runtime results. Format lists are bounded reading-format inventories, not exhaustive conversion matrices.

alternatives.name: Adobe Acrobat Reader for Android
alternatives.license: Commercial application; a full-app open-source license was not established in reviewed official material.
alternatives.source_availability: Full current Android app source unavailable in reviewed official material.

features.name: PDF reading, highlights, comments, and sticky notes
Fill PDF forms and add handwritten signatures
Liquid Mode for a screen-fitting reading layout
limitations: The detailed help is visibly dated 2025-08-07; its server-processing description and compatibility limits were not retested on the current app.

features.name: File access from the device, Google Drive, OneDrive, and Dropbox
PDF editing, conversion, OCR, compression, and page operations
Read-aloud with higher-quality voice options
features.entitlement: Higher-quality voices are listed under Premium; all voice and mode combinations were not established.

sources.scope: Android package and advertised free/Premium capabilities.
Official mobile product description; successful parsed fetch, although a separate direct fetch returned 403.
Official mobile overview, including reading, cloud, audio, and support topics.
Android Liquid Mode help; visible last update 2025-08-07 12:37.

limitations: No application installation, execution, or decompilation was performed for this documentation review.
Mobile Reader and desktop Acrobat Pro are distinct comparison targets.

The dated Liquid Mode page describes server processing and deletion after layout generation, possible limits above 200 pages or 10 MB, and restrictions involving scans, encryption, languages, and complex layouts. It documents TalkBack support and says Dark Mode is not supported; current runtime restrictions remain unverified.
A source-code repository for the complete current Android product was not established; this does not classify every Adobe library as closed-source.
No exact installed version, performance result, or successful cloud/voice workflow was established.

alternatives.name: ReadEra and ReadEra Premium
alternatives.license: Proprietary ReadEra application; separate GPL OpenReadEra renderer programs.
alternatives.source_availability: Full-app source unavailable in reviewed material. Source for the separate EraPDF, EraEPUB, EraDjVu, EraComic, and EraMOBI programs is offered by email on the official OpenReadEra page.

features.name: Broad-format local library with authors, series, collections, folders, and file management
Quotes, notes, bookmarks, and dictionary/translation integration
PDF margin cropping
Duplicate detection and retention of reading state after files move or are deleted
limitations: This is a publisher claim, not a verified content-identity algorithm or recovery test.

features.name: Multiple documents using Android multi-window and task switching
limitations: Do not equate the documented Android two-window workflow with an in-app desktop-style tab interface.

features.name: Google Drive book/state sync and background TTS
Cross-book quotes/notes/dictionary, custom fonts, page thumbnails, and library layouts
Markdown reading with search, TTS, and formatting styles
limitations: Recorded from the Premium listing's What's new section, whose visible update date was 2026-11-07; no exact installed version was examined.

sources.scope: Official homepage and fuller page read: formats, library, cropping, duplicate detection, persistent state, multi-window, and free/no-ads/no-registration claims.
Premium capabilities and one-payment statement.
Premium Android package/features; visible Updated on 2026-11-07 and Markdown/backup changes.
Proprietary app license and explicit separation of GPL helper programs.
Five independent GPL renderer programs; source-request address support@readera.org. No source was requested or received.

No app installation, runtime test, decompilation, or helper-source request was performed.
This product is a plausible Reader Pro name-confusion candidate, not a resolved identity.

Android-specific pages support these claims; desktop or cross-platform tools are not automatically assigned to Android.
Shared terms do not establish the exact current Android entitlement for each advertised tool.
No application installation, runtime, decompilation, or complete current source review was performed.
This is a bounded documented comparison, not an exhaustive market inventory or a ranking.
Repository null means no repository for the complete current app was established; legacy code and independently licensed helpers are qualified in each record.
Readest and Librera identity evidence and commit-pinned README/license observations remain in the linked Markdown dossier; they are not duplicated as commercial product-family entries here.
Official feature claims, source availability, source inspection, and runtime success are different evidence categories.
Source retrieval dates do not imply document publication dates, current-version checks, or working features.
No emails, source requests, upstream issues, or upstream pull requests were submitted for this documentation work.
